Cost per task is simple: minutes divided by 60, times the hourly rate. A 15-minute task at $5.62 an hour is $1.40. At the $12 pay-as-you-go rate it is $3.00.

The guide has the full table by plan, plus example tasks with the assumed minutes shown.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/virtual-assistant-cost-per-task?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=pr1-task

To pick a plan, list your repeat jobs, note the minutes each takes, add them up and divide by 60. Under 5 hours a month suits a small block or pay-as-you-go. Work that fills the month suits the 160-hour plan.

Unused hours roll over while your account is active.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/affordable-virtual-assistant-monthly-plans?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=pr2-plans

Hosts answer the same ten guest questions all year. Saved answers, a calendar check and a cleaner schedule are easy to hand off. Keys, cleaning and emergencies stay with you or a local co-host.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/virtual-assistant-for-airbnb-hosts?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ab1-hosts

Full-time dedicated virtual assistant: 160 hours for $899, or $5.62 an hour. Part-time is 80 hours for $500.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/dedicated-virtual-assistant?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=da1-160
